what: Cross-check, not a check of this change: Claude's reproduced finding C1 on the agent-written fix 2283 (the location filter drops MsgPack003; evidence/repros/2283/C1) run against PR #2305, to see whether the human fix has the same regression
how: test copied to tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/CountersignRepro/ in scratch worktrees /data/src/mp-repro-up2305-C1-{head,base} (global.json set to SDK 9.0.321 there only), evidence/scripts/run.sh with --filter FullyQualifiedName~ReproClaude2283C1Tests
result: passes on both: PR #2305 still reports MsgPack003 for Lib.Item<App.Foo>; the regression Claude found in the agent's fix (failed on 2283 head, passed on its base) is not in the human fix
not_a_check_because: repro.* checks route a change as a reproduced defect; this test was written for another change, so it is kept beside the facts, not in them
